skill.name: mp-groundline
compatibility: system vince-mp CLI (for the verify step only)

change.summary_zh: 0.2.2 第三轮修复（owner 2026-09-25 授权）：修掉 0.2.0 修复审计遗留的 OD1（packOptions.ignore 文件夹里的已声明页面照常扫描，不再静默漏报 rewrite）、OD2（默认布局提示只指向在 Skyline 上跑过的页面）以及 P3 的 OD3/OD5/OD6/OD7/OD8/OD9；OD4（同行带引号正则后的 wx:// 路由漏报）是 0.1.x 就有的已知限制，保留为开放项。行为改动见 CHANGELOG 0.2.2。
change.summary_en: 0.2.2 third fix round (owner-authorized 2026-09-25): fixes the 0.2.0 fix-audit residuals OD1 (a declared page inside a packOptions.ignore folder is scanned; no silent rewrite drop), OD2 (default-layout advice scoped to the pages that ran on Skyline) and P3s OD3/OD5/OD6/OD7/OD8/OD9; OD4 (wx:// route after a same-line quote-bearing regex literal) is a known limit already present in 0.1.x and stays open. Behavior changes: see CHANGELOG 0.2.2.

gate_conditions: validate-skill green (scripts/validate-skill.mjs, local-only) on the dev checkout AND re-run on each install root after every deploy
deterministic eval harness green (node evals/run_all.mjs -> exit 0, 55/55; includes the generator structure/injection cases and the R3 regression cases)
E11 with/without two-arm evidence (A44) recorded in assets/metric-plan.json
waived_check_ids: real-program-smoke: scan-only smoke done 2026-09-25 on both deep-scan programs and wxa.cli.im; a DevTools before/after run was not possible offline (the earlier 'program no longer on disk' waiver was false)
trigger-eval: never run since 0.1.0; description unchanged through 0.2.2 (waived, open for the next K2 review)
adversarial-checklist-16/16: 0.1.0 build-time evidence, superseded by the 49-case harness and the R20 battery; not re-run

known-limit-OD4: a wx:// route on the same JS line after a quote-bearing regex literal is missed (documented in references/scanner-contract.md; present in installed 0.1.1 too, so not a regression; a fix needs regex-literal parsing)
carried-P3s F09 F12 F13 F15 F16 F17(remainder) F04r: battery round-1 P3s, all present in 0.1.1; not fixed in this wave (see CHANGELOG)
r3-fix-audit: the 0.2.2 fix round (OD1-OD9) has red->green regression cases and a full-corpus row diff but no independent fix audit yet; the conductor rules whether one is owed before deploy

rollback_trigger: false rewrite on a clean program
rollback.migration_target_rollback: the SKILL's own migration edits a git working tree: revert = git checkout app.json + touched page json

deprecation.note: If WeChat removes the Skyline renderer or vince-mp's CLI contract changes, re-version references/skyline-to-webview.md against the on-disk skyline-* skills and update rules/verify-with-vince-mp.md.
